decision: Do not invoke --upload under this run or retry it. Preserve authoritative public v0 and correct the documentation. Any future redacted distribution must use a new content-addressed publication contract and run ID.

findings.detail: A latest-is-v0 preflight cannot atomically reserve v1. A concurrent or partially completed publication can commit v2 before the postcondition rejects it, leaving an irreversible remote mutation without a local receipt.
Credentialed SDK download verification does not prove the preregistered anonymous public-read gate.
The preregistration did not bind a clean source commit, entity, or the builder, publisher, and test hashes, and the publisher did not verify the preregistration bytes.
The generic redaction code predated newly protected adjacent Kimi IDs 464346 and 464367. The pinned local view contains neither ID, but the source policy and tests were not current.
